name: com.reromanlee.reactivelocalizer
description: Localization for any project size, from a five-minute prototype to hundreds of thousands of entries. Text tables live as mergeable files per language, keys are checked at compile time, ICU plurals and arguments get typed generated methods, and reactive bindings follow language switches without any per-frame work. A pure C# core with no dependencies runs on every platform, WebGL included, with a table editor, validation, and spreadsheet, XLIFF and LLM exchange in the Editor.

samples.description: Everything a prototype needs: GlobalLocalizer, a project-wide access point that remembers the player's language and maps the OS language; a language picker; and a scene whose texts follow every switch, in English, Russian and an invented Pirate language that falls back to English.

A component that shows an entry in a TextMeshPro text through every language switch, and a Localize action in the text's context menu that turns its current text into a new entry in one click. Import Quick Start first.
